t=df['t'].values; P=df['P'].values; y=df['dP_dt'].values
m=P<0.6
print(m.sum())
o=np.argsort(t[m])
tt=t[m][o]; yy=y[m][o]; pp=P[m][o]
def f1(X,a,b,c): 
    t,P=X; return -a*t**b - c*P
p,_=curve_fit(f1,(tt,pp),yy,p0=[2,0.5,0])
print('power+linP',p, np.mean((f1((tt,pp),*p)-yy)**2)/np.var(yy))
def f2(X,a,b,c,d):
    t,P=X; return -a*t**b*(1-np.exp(-c*P)) - d*P
p2,_=curve_fit(f2,(tt,pp),yy,p0=[2,0.5,1,0.1],maxfev=20000)
print('f2',p2, np.mean((f2((tt,pp),*p2)-yy)**2)/np.var(yy))
def f3(X,a,b,c,d):
    t,P=X; return -a*t**b - c*t*P - d*P
p3,_=curve_fit(f3,(tt,pp),yy,p0=[2,0.5,0.1,0.1],maxfev=20000)
print('f3',p3, np.mean((f3((tt,pp),*p3)-yy)**2)/np.var(yy))
